title: Phase 2: SA-vs-QPU testing framework on identical Ising models
description:
Re-calibrate both engines for the extreme end (with a shipped-params baseline), then run a paired equal-attempts SA-vs-QPU comparison on identical hardest_models instances (same order + K orderings as a drift control), analyzed as McNemar + pooled by hardness bin.

GLOBAL CONSTRAINTS (every task):
- .quip venv (uv); ruff + ty clean; AGPL header; absolute imports; <=100 lines/function; Google docstrings; no LLM co-author trailers.
- Scripts under test_results/hardest_models/tools/phase2/; data under test_results/sa_vs_qpu_paired/. NEVER cross-pool topology buckets.
- Held-out split: Stage A (calibration+baseline) uses ONLY the calibration slice; Stage B (comparison) uses ONLY the comparison slice. Params never tuned on the instances they are judged on.
- Fresh QPU approved but quota-sized and OPERATOR-LAUNCHED, never backgrounded.

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-08-sa-vs-qpu-same-instances-hardness-edge-design.md
Consumes Phase 1 hardest_models + regen_verify.load_instance.

title: Phase 1: hardest_models corpus acquisition & characterization
description:
Build the `hardest_models` corpus: Ising instances at the hardness edge, bucketed by topology_hash, ranked by lowest achieved energy, with a structural characterization/filter analysis. Feeds Phase 2 (SA-vs-QPU testing framework).

GLOBAL CONSTRAINTS (apply to every task):
- Python via the .quip venv (uv); ruff + ty clean; AGPL header on new files; absolute imports; <=100 lines/function; Google docstrings; no LLM co-author lines in commits.
- Scripts live under test_results/hardest_models/tools/ (local, per phase-B precedent). Data output under test_results/hardest_models/<topology_hash>/. test_results is gitignored; beads is stealth. Do not commit unless asked; branch study/sa-vs-qpu-paired first when we do.
- topology_hash = shared/topology_hash.py:topology_hash(nodes,edges,allowed_h,allowed_j,allowed_spin). NEVER cross-pool topology buckets (h0 vs ternary are different hashes/scales).
- Any live chain/QPU call is read-only and operator-launched; NEVER backgrounded.

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-08-phase1-corpus-acquisition-characterization-design.md
Tasks: harvest -> chain pull+snapshot -> regen/verify -> rank/select -> characterize -> smoke.
notes: 2026-07-08: beads UN-STEALTHED for cross-machine work (different hardware). Sync via git: .beads/issues.jsonl is committed; on another machine, git pull then 'bd import .beads/issues.jsonl' (or 'bd bootstrap'). The earlier 'beads is stealth' line in the description is superseded.
